sections.Overview:
Costco Wholesale Corporation operates membership warehouses and e-commerce sites principally in the United States and internationally across multiple countries including Canada, Mexico, Japan, the U.K., Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Sweden, Iceland, and New Zealand. The company operates based on a membership model where it offers a limited selection of nationally-branded and private-label products at low prices, achieving high sales volumes and rapid inventory turnover through volume purchasing and efficient distribution. Costco operates 939 warehouses as of August 30, 2026, with an average warehouse size of approximately 148,000 square feet. The product assortment in warehouses is limited to less than 4,000 SKUs, while the e-commerce platform offers 9,000 to 11,000 SKUs, providing members access to a broader selection. Ancillary businesses include gasoline stations, pharmacies, food courts, optical and hearing aids, and other services adjacent to warehouses. The company emphasizes membership satisfaction with return policies and additional services such as extended warranties on electronics. Membership fees were $65 annually in the U.S., and membership renewal rates were 92.3% in the U.S. and Canada and 89.8% worldwide as of the end of fiscal 2026. ("We operate membership warehouses and e-commerce sites..."; "Costco operated 939...warehouses worldwide at August 30, 2026."; "Our average warehouse space is approximately 148,000 square feet"; "We carry less than 4,000 active stock keeping units (SKUs) per warehouse..."; "Membership at the end of 2026...Paid members 84,100 [thousands]"; "Our member renewal rate was 92.3% in the U.S. and Canada...") [10-K accession 0000909832-26-000093, lines L000733-L000745, L000773-L000784].

Insight: The company’s operational performance is significantly dependent on its U.S. and Canadian markets which composed 86% of net sales in 2026, posing a concentration risk that could materially affect overall results if these regions underperform [10-K accession 0000909832-26-000093 L000836]. [C: region_sales_dependency]
sections.Market Positioning and Growth Outlook: Costco’s competitive positioning is anchored on its membership warehouse model delivering high-volume sales of a limited range of quality products at low prices enabled by efficient supply chain management, including direct purchasing and a cross-docking distribution system. Its warehouse design and operational efficiencies contribute to lower labor costs and reduced shrinkage. The company leverages a broad geographic presence with warehouses in multiple countries and a growing e-commerce platform that expands product assortment beyond the physical warehouses. Executive memberships provide incentive-driven loyalty with an additional annual fee and rewards. Growth catalysts include expansion of warehouse count (939 warehouses at fiscal 2026 year-end), increasing penetration of Executive members (42,300 thousands in 2026), and ancillary business development such as gasoline stations which contributed 11% of net sales in 2026. However, the company faces risks including dependency on the U.S. and Canadian markets that comprised 86% of net sales in 2026, competitive real estate acquisition for warehouse expansion, and market entry challenges in new regions. ("We operate membership warehouses and e-commerce sites..."; "Executive members represented 42,300 [thousands]...in 2026"; "Our gasoline business represented 11% of total net sales in 2026."; "Our financial and operational performance is highly dependent on our U.S. and Canadian operations, which comprised 86%...of net sales in 2026.") [10-K accession 0000909832-26-000093 lines L000733-L000737, L000764, L000782, L000836-L000837].
sections.Valuation Insights:
Costco Wholesale Corporation reported annual total revenue of $303.154 billion for the fiscal year ended August 30, 2026, representing a growth of 10.14% over the prior year [C:revenue_current], [C:revenue_prior], [C:revenue_growth]. Operating income for the year was $11.685 billion, yielding an operating margin of 3.85% [C:operating_income_current], [C:operating_margin]. Net income attributable to the company was $9.226 billion for the fiscal year [C:net_income_current]. The company’s GAAP diluted earnings per share (EPS) were $20.76 [C:diluted_eps_current]. Return on average equity stood at 28.40%, calculated using average shareholders' equity [C:return_on_average_equity]. Costco’s debt to equity ratio, including the current portion of debt, was 0.172 [C:debt_to_equity]. The free cash flow for the fiscal year was $9.382 billion, derived from net cash provided by operations minus capital expenditures [C:free_cash_flow].

Regarding the latest reported quarter, net sales increased 11.2% to $93.9 billion from $84.4 billion in the same quarter last year, although the exact total revenue for the quarter is Not established due to lack of unambiguous data [C:quarterly_revenue]. The latest quarter GAAP diluted EPS was $6.75 [C:latest_quarter_eps]. Given the closing price of $904.7 on September 23, 2026, the price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio based on annual GAAP diluted EPS is 43.58 [C:price_to_earnings].

Operating margins of peers on a consistent total revenue basis show Walmart Inc. at 4.18% [C:peer_wmt_operating_margin], TARGET CORP at 4.88% [C:peer_tgt_operating_margin], and BJ's Wholesale Club Holdings, Inc. at 3.81% [C:peer_bj_operating_margin]. Costco’s operating margin is slightly lower than Walmart and Target but higher than BJ's.

[Cautions: The revenue figure uses the contract-sales tag; it should be verified to include all total revenue components, not just net sales.]

Insight: Costco’s long-term debt excluding current portion decreased to $3.914 billion at August 30, 2026, from $5.713 billion at August 31, 2025, indicating a reduction in longer-term leverage risk [C:long_term_debt_current_noncurrent], 10-K 0000909832-26-000093 L000123.
sections.Future Developments and Strategic Recomm: Costco continues to pursue growth through new warehouse openings in both existing and new markets, expansion of its e-commerce platform, and ancillary services growth such as fuel stations and business centers. The company aims to increase operational efficiency by expanding supply-chain diversification and in-country production. Management acknowledges challenges including local land use restrictions for new warehouses, competitive pressures in established and new markets, and risks associated with cannibalization of sales from new warehouses. Strategic recommendations include focused execution on selective warehouse expansion in attractive markets to avoid adverse impacts on existing locations, continued enhancement of online offerings to complement physical stores, and leveraging the high renewal rates and engagement of Executive members for increased revenue capture. Monitoring risks due to heavy dependence on U.S. and Canadian markets is also critical. ("Our growth is dependent...on our ability to acquire property and build or lease new warehouses..."; "We intend to continue to open warehouses in new markets..."; "We cannot ensure that new warehouses..." might avoid cannibalization.) [10-K accession 0000909832-26-000093 lines L000838-L000841].
sections.Investment Recommendation:
Hold provisional: The deciding metric is the operating margin at 3.85% [C:operating_margin], which is slightly below peer leaders Walmart and Target (4.18% and 4.88%, respectively), indicating only moderate operating efficiency and profit expansion. This margin position, combined with strong revenue growth of 10.14% [C:revenue_growth] but a high P/E ratio of 43.58 [C:price_to_earnings], suggests valuation premium with limited margin improvement visibility. Therefore, with moderate margin and elevated valuation, the evidence supports a Hold stance until next filings clarify margin trajectory or valuation justification.

Insight: Costco’s long-term debt excluding the current portion decreased to $3.914 billion at August 30, 2026, from $5.713 billion at August 31, 2025, indicating a reduction in longer-term leverage risk [C:long_term_debt_current_noncurrent], 10-K 0000909832-26-000093 L000123.

COSTCO WHOLESALE CORPORATION REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER AND FISCAL YEAR 2026 OPERATING RESULTS
ISSAQUAH, Wash., September 24, 2026 - Costco Wholesale Corporation (“Costco” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: COST) today announced its operating results for the 16-week fourth quarter and the 52-week fiscal year ended August 30, 2026.
Net sales for the quarter increased 11.2 percent, to $93.9 billion, from $84.4 billion last year. Net sales for the fiscal year increased 10.1 percent, to $297.2 billion, from $269.9 billion last year.
Comparable sales for the fourth quarter and fiscal year were as follows:

|  |  | Adjusted* |  |  |  | Adjusted*
U.S. | 10.7% |  | 7.2% |  | 8.2% |  | 6.6%

Other International | 7.0% |  | 6.2% |  | 9.8% |  | 6.5%
Total Company | 9.4% |  | 6.7% |  | 8.4% |  | 6.6%
Digitally-Enabled | 19.5% |  | 19.8% |  | 20.9% |  | 20.7%
*Excluding the impacts from changes in gasoline prices and foreign exchange.
Net income for the fourth quarter was $2.998 billion, $6.75 per diluted share, compared to $2.610 billion, $5.87 per diluted share, last year. This year's fourth quarter was positively impacted by a non-recurring benefit of $0.15 per diluted share from IEEPA tariff refunds received in the quarter, less partial reinvestment of those refunds in increased member values. Net income for the fiscal year was $9.226 billion, $20.76 per diluted share, compared to $8.099 billion, $18.21 per diluted share, last year.
Costco currently operates 939 warehouses, including 647 in the United States and Puerto Rico, 115 in Canada, 43 in Mexico, 37 in Japan, 29 in the United Kingdom, 20 in Korea, 15 in Australia, 14 in Taiwan, seven in China, five in Spain, three in France, two in Sweden, and one each in Iceland, and New Zealand. Costco also operates e-commerce sites in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Mexico, Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Australia, and China.
A conference call to discuss these results is scheduled for 2:00 p.m. (PT) today, September 24, 2026, and will be available via a webcast on investor.costco.com (click “Events & Presentations”).
